breakeven_cost_bps.note: per-variant round-trip cost at which mean gross return reaches zero; the reported figure is the median OF those points, not the breakeven of the median variant

market_beta.note: market = equal-weighted mean return of the investable universe

mechanism: MIXED. Gross returns are neither clearly zero nor clearly positive.

null_calibration.note: Each asset's returns were shuffled independently: same per-asset distribution, no cross-sectional or serial structure. A value inside this spread is an artefact of the measurement, not a property of the market.
